Kforce's client in Lakewood, CO is seeking a Golang/Python Developer responsible for supporting existing software products while building a new greenfield application.

Summary:
This role offers the opportunity to work across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, technical specifications, application development, database work, front-end development, and DevOps. The ideal candidate is a well-rounded software engineer who enjoys working across the full stack rather than focusing exclusively on one component of an application. The role is weighted toward backend development, but hands-on front-end experience is required.

What You'll Do:
 
  Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications across the full stack 
  Develop backend applications using Go and Python 
  Build and maintain front-end applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS 
  Work with relational databases, including PostgreSQL 
  Support two existing software products while contributing to the development of a new greenfield product that will consolidate capabilities from those applications 
  Participate throughout the development lifecycle, from gathering requirements and designing solutions through coding and deployment 
  Contribute to DevOps responsibilities 
  Help evaluate technical approaches and influence technology decisions for a product still being defined 
  Participate actively in stand-ups, ask questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and contribute ideas to improve the product and engineering approach 
  Experiment with different solutions and work in an agile environment that emphasizes iteration and learning quickly 
 
 
  3-5 years of professional software engineering experience 
  Experience developing software applications using Go and Python, or a strong software engineering background with transferable experience in comparable languages 
  Full-stack development experience with a strong backend foundation 
  Experience working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL 
  Ability to understand and contribute across multiple layers of an application rather than working exclusively within a single area such as APIs or databases 
  Ability to explain technical decisions, coding approaches, and problem-solving methodology 
  Strong communication skills and willingness to contribute actively within a small engineering team 

 
Experience developing front-end web applications using:
 
  React 
  JavaScript 
  TypeScript 
  HTML 
  CSS 

 
Experience in any of the following would be highly valuable:
 
  TimescaleDB or other time-series databases 
  Event-driven systems 
  Internet of Things (IoT) applications 
  AI-enabled development environments 
  Greenfield product development 
  DevOps 
  Database schema design 
  End-to-end product development 
  UI/UX principles or the ability to provide thoughtful input on front-end design and usability 

 
This role is best suited for an engineer who wants broad ownership rather than a narrowly defined development function. The team is specifically looking for someone who will speak up during stand-ups, ask questions, constructively challenge assumptions, and bring a forward-thinking, entrepreneurial approach to engineering.
